examples.name: Two-level trail
examples.description: One ancestor link, current page last.

examples.name: Deep trail
examples.jsx:
<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings' },
    { label: 'Account', href: '/settings/account' },
    { label: 'Security' },
  ]}
/>

examples.name: With a leading icon
examples.description: A home icon before the first crumb's label.
examples.jsx:
<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/', iconBefore: <HomeIcon size="sm" /> },
    { label: 'Reports', href: '/reports' },
    { label: 'Q3 Summary' },
  ]}
/>

examples.name: Custom accessible name
examples.jsx:
<Breadcrumbs
  ariaLabel="You are here"
  items={[
    { label: 'Docs', href: '/docs' },
    { label: 'Components' },
  ]}
/>

examples.name: Single item (current page only)
examples.description: A top-level page with no ancestors - renders as plain current-page text, no separator.

antiExamples.name: Current item with an href
antiExamples.reason: Giving the last item an href makes it render as a clickable Link instead of the aria-current="page" current-page marker - omit href on the last item unless it should genuinely be a link.

antiExamples.name: Progress through an unvisited flow
antiExamples.reason: Breadcrumbs shows a location trail of visited/navigable ancestors, not linear progress through unvisited steps - use Progress Indicator instead.
